Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Land Tax
Unique Master
1

During their untap phase, all Methuselah must pay 1 pool for each location they control.

This card can be burned by any minion as a  action.

Messages.Author: Molloy
Messages.Body:
I don't think the card is a good idea. What problem is it fixing? What strategy is it empowering? What amusement value does it add to the game?

If there is a card like this, it needs to be more like Arika's special. Otherwise, a player could have to burn lots of pool or something with no recourse, since they'll burn the pool before they have a chance to burn the card. That's too jarring to the game.

Sabbat. Animals, Wraiths and Zombies Molloy recruits or employs get an additional life.

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Arcanun is only for prey/predator and for HG's.

This card is more like "Pay for your parthenon or for your heidelberg".

Unlike arika it does not give the location owner the opportunity to burn the locations.

Its more in a disruptive strategy of not letting other players setting up their decks... If you are playing with a Parthenon or a Heidelberg this card can ruin your plans...

Euh ? Most deck types use 1 or 2 locations in x1 maximum, and so have a location in play at max. And not every games.

The card is unhelpful for you, because even in the case your predator play a lot of location, you want him to stop use them, not give a VP and 6 pool to your grandpredator. And unlike your example, you can't do anything to make your prey suffer more than the other methuselah.

The card is completelety uninteractive (you can't even sacrifice your locations !), so it's a Very Bad Idea anyhow.

Arika is hated not because its special, even if it help. Arika is feared because she have 4 votes, 3 bleed,  and two other good vampires with vote, , and good specials. She could be blank, it won't change a lot of thing.

In short, you have a bad idea, this card is unsalveageable, but it happen to most card idea.
